answer: Proposed: one vote/key/day on mapping a nebula's relic emission, backed by an exclusive rented 10-minute telescope slot. Validators check observatory-signed key/day receipts for reuse or overlap; failure denies the vote. A shared calibration kernel saves compute, not telescope time. Rental recurs; optics are reusable capital; no stake is locked. The observatory could fake usage, and wealth buys aliases. Ten concurrent keys still need 100 telescope-minutes/day.
